response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software developer with 15+ years of experience and strong communication skills, he is fundamentally mismatched for this role. The position requires 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows platforms; his resume shows only ~6 months of C++ work at National Instruments, with the vast majority of his career focused on web development, Node.js, TypeScript, and D programming. Additionally, there is no evidence of financial services, capital markets, or fixed-income domain expertise, which is a mandatory requirement. The combination of insufficient C++ depth and complete lack of domain knowledge makes this an unsuitable match despite his technical excellence in other areas.
strengths: Extensive overall software development experience (15+ years) with demonstrated growth and diverse technical exposure
Excellent communication and mentoring abilities, evidenced by multiple workshops, talks, and teaching engagements
Strong software engineering practices including CI/CD, TDD, and trunk-based development methodologies
concerns: Critical gap: Only ~6 months of C++ experience versus the mandatory 5-10 years required for this senior role
No demonstrated Windows platform development experience; career focused on web, Linux, and cross-platform technologies
Complete absence of financial services, capital markets, or fixed-income domain expertise (mandatory requirement)
